title: Finding report
//: The one shape every checking tool's --json emits. Eight tools used to answer eight different ways - an array here, {errors,warnings} there, {new,fixed} somewhere else - and anything that wanted to read them all (the dashboard, a CI summary, a release record) had to know each one. This is the envelope: what ran, whether it passed, and a flat list of findings that all look alike. The tool's own detail is kept whole under `data`, so nothing a tool used to say is lost - it is just no longer the only way it says it.

ok.description: Did the command pass. Always false when any finding is `block`.

skipped.description: True when there was nothing to check - no criteria, no promoted architecture, no dependencies. ok is true and findings is empty; the summary says why.

exit.description: The process exit code: 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 nothing to check.

summary.description: One line, the same sentence the text mode ends with.

counts.description: Findings by severity, so a reader need not count.

data.description: The tool's own full result, unchanged in shape from before the envelope existed. May be null when the tool was skipped.

severity.description: block fails the command. warn is reported and does not fail (unless the tool was run --strict, in which case it is emitted as block). info is context.

code.description: Stable, per tool, kebab-case. What kind of finding - `uncovered`, `expired-flag`, `dangling-id`. Not the message.

message.description: One sentence a person can act on.

file.description: Repo-relative path, when the finding is about a file.

ref.description: The id or name the finding is about - AC-12, INC-0003, PaymentsGateway - when it is not a file.

detail.description: Tool-specific extra, kept small. Readers must not need it.
